lesson.scenario: An LSM database performs generation-safe anti-entropy by comparing immutable-SSTable Merkle manifests and journaling repairs.

steps.title: Seal comparable manifests
steps.narration: Both replicas pause anti-entropy on immutable generation 912, use identical token ranges, and hash key,timestamp,tombstone,value bytes.

tree.detail: No work accepted in this phase

journal.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.outcome: Compaction cannot change the compared input mid-session.
steps.invariant: A repair session compares one immutable generation with identical range and serialization rules, transfers versioned rows in the direction of newest state, preserves tombstones, and finishes only after rebuilt roots match.

steps.title: Exchange range roots
steps.narration: 255 range roots match; token range [0xA800,0xA8FF] differs, so all equal ranges are pruned immediately.

journal.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.outcome: The session isolates one suspect range.
steps.invariant: A repair session compares one immutable generation with identical range and serialization rules, transfers versioned rows in the direction of newest state, preserves tombstones, and finishes only after rebuilt roots match.

steps.title: Descend to row hashes
steps.narration: Three levels identify rows K-18 and K-92; K-18 is newer on A, while B carries a newer tombstone for K-92.

journal.detail: put K-18@44 A->B; tombstone K-92@51 B->A

steps.outcome: Repair direction is decided per version, not per replica.
steps.invariant: A repair session compares one immutable generation with identical range and serialization rules, transfers versioned rows in the direction of newest state, preserves tombstones, and finishes only after rebuilt roots match.

steps.title: Apply idempotent repairs
steps.narration: B accepts K-18@44; the reverse journal operation applies tombstone K-92@51 to A, and repeated operations compare equal timestamps.
action: Put K-18 only if timestamp below 44
steps.outcome: Repair cannot overwrite a newer concurrent compaction result.
steps.invariant: A repair session compares one immutable generation with identical range and serialization rules, transfers versioned rows in the direction of newest state, preserves tombstones, and finishes only after rebuilt roots match.

steps.title: Verify and release the generation
steps.narration: Both manifests now compute range root 4c91 and common global root ff20; pinned SSTables are released only after journal durability.
steps.outcome: Anti-entropy ends with cryptographic agreement and replayable evidence.
steps.invariant: A repair session compares one immutable generation with identical range and serialization rules, transfers versioned rows in the direction of newest state, preserves tombstones, and finishes only after rebuilt roots match.

production.scenario: Azure Cosmos DB product catalog replicas use digest comparison to localize divergence before streaming repairs across regions.
components: global merchandising systems updating price and availability records
service boundary that validates writes and exposes region repair controls
control-plane service that compares replica digests and narrows anti-entropy work to mismatched ranges
durable authority in multi-region Cosmos DB containers for the product catalog
serve local read traffic and receive targeted repair streams from the authority
control path that schedules range scans, throttles copy work, and retries failures
observability path for divergent partitions, scan cost, and customer read risk
flows: Merchandising systems write price or availability changes through the catalog boundary.
The authoritative multi-region container records the accepted catalog mutation durably.
The repair coordinator asks the Merkle tree service to compare selected replica ranges.
Only the ranges with digest mismatches are selected for targeted repair.
Stale replicas fetch the rows they are missing from the durable catalog authority.
The authority sends the corrected documents and tombstones for the divergent ranges.
Operators monitor mismatch density, repair throughput, and stale-read exposure by region.
